title: GNOME Extension Manifest Schema
description: Schema for validating GNOME extension compatibility metadata, installation methods, and presets in macKali.

uuid.description: Verified unique extension identifier (UUID) matching metadata.json.

uuid_verified.description: True if UUID has been validated against official upstream repository or extensions.gnome.org.

repository.description: URL of upstream source repository (e.g. GitHub, GitLab).

supported_gnome_versions.description: GNOME Shell major versions supported by upstream metadata.

versions_verified.description: True if compatibility has been verified against upstream metadata.json.

installation_method.description: Mechanism used to download and install extension.

enabled_presets.description: macKali installation presets where this extension is activated.

settings_schema.description: GSettings schema ID used for configuring extension settings.

known_conflicts.description: List of conflicting extension UUIDs or desktop components.

installation_status.description: Current tracking status. In Phase 1, all extensions are marked 'planned'.

notes.description: Operational notes, workarounds, or configuration hints.

unverified_fields.description: List of any fields requiring further manual or automated verification.
